operationVerification.description: Image/audio admission MIME, size, extension/canonical form, content hash ve tenant-bound metadata kontrollerini dogrula.
Sanitized storage object key, content download ve bounded range/stream davranisini dogrula.
Vision/transcription provider gate'lerinin mock-only audit kosusunda ve explicit real-egress kapisi arkasinda oldugunu dogrula.
Durable media/transcription worker claim, lease renewal, provider deadline, retry ve terminal review/failed outcome'larini dogrula.
Observation/transcript validation, source authority, quality gate ve human review etiketlerini dogrula.
Media/audio lifecycle retention, revoke, purge ve object-delete release yolunu idempotent olarak dogrula.
